The numbers over the run's counted conversations: the latest attempt of each repeat,
unless it was cancelled.

Writes scenarios and streams each one as it is saved. Closing the stream stops the
generation; what is saved stays.

AgentSummary.title: AgentSummary
AgentSummary.description: An agent without its config and knowledge base, for lists.

AssignPersona.title: AssignPersona
AssignPersona.description: One persona for several scenarios of one agent: all of them, or none if one is missing.

Category.title: Category
Category.description: What kind of situation a scenario tests. How the caller talks comes from the persona.

Defaults.title: Defaults
Defaults.description: What the server uses for a field that a request leaves out.

DocumentSummary.title: DocumentSummary
DocumentSummary.description: A document without its text, for lists and upload results.

EndReason.title: EndReason
EndReason.description: Who or what ended the conversation, as Truman observed it.

Fact.title: Fact
Fact.description: A value the caller has and gives when the agent asks for it.

KnowledgeBaseDocument.title: KnowledgeBaseDocument
KnowledgeBaseDocument.description: A knowledge base entry with what the list shows about its document.

KnowledgeBaseEntry.title: KnowledgeBaseEntry
KnowledgeBaseEntry.description: A document the agent answers from, under the name the agent shows for it.

LatencySummary.title: LatencySummary
LatencySummary.description:
The agent's response times in one call: nearest-rank percentiles over the measured
replies, how many replies there were, and how many of them talked over the caller.

Metric.title: Metric
Metric.description: One metric's value and the flags it raised.

NoiseLevel.title: NoiseLevel
NoiseLevel.description: How loud the background is, as the caller's speech level above the noise.

OutboundConfig.title: OutboundConfig
OutboundConfig.description: How an outbound agent is made to call Truman, and how its call is recognized.

OutcomeGroup.title: OutcomeGroup
OutcomeGroup.description:
How a conversation went, from its status and end reason only. Before any judge, the
groups say what happened, not who is at fault.

PersonaConfig.title: PersonaConfig
PersonaConfig.description: What a persona version pins: the settings plus the voice gender from the voices list.

ProviderVoice.title: ProviderVoice
ProviderVoice.description:
A voice as its provider describes it. `listed_languages` are the languages the provider
lists for the voice in any model; the model decides what the voice can really speak.

Reply.title: Reply
Reply.description: The agent's answer to one caller reply, or to the start of the call.

RunCreate.title: RunCreate
RunCreate.description:
Limits that an operator sets, such as the most repeats, are checked where the settings
are known.

RunNumbers.title: RunNumbers
RunNumbers.description: What the evaluations found over some of a run's conversations.

ScenarioConfig.title: ScenarioConfig
ScenarioConfig.description:
What a scenario version pins. The goal and the facts go to the caller. The criteria never
do: they are what the agent must say or do on the call. Agent data goes only to the agent,
in an outbound agent's trigger.

ScenarioDelete.title: ScenarioDelete
ScenarioDelete.description: Scenarios of one agent to delete together: all of them, or none if one is missing.

ScenarioUpdate.title: ScenarioUpdate
ScenarioUpdate.description: A partial change; lists replace the stored list as a whole.

Share.title: Share
Share.description:
How many of a total, with the 95% Wilson interval of the rate: few calls give a wide
interval.

Transport.title: Transport
Transport.description: How Truman reaches an agent; phone only today, kept as the seam for other ways.

Trigger.title: Trigger
Trigger.description: A POST with a JSON body, sent once for each conversation.

VoiceSettings.title: VoiceSettings
VoiceSettings.description:
A voice of one text-to-speech provider and how it speaks; the id means nothing
outside that provider. The id goes into provider URLs, so dots and slashes are refused.

WaitingReason.title: WaitingReason
WaitingReason.description:
Why queued conversations of a run have not started. Only the run's own limits are
named; anything else is a worker or a number.
